question: A vendor bought oranges at 5 for ₹15 and sold them at 3 for ₹5. Find his loss percent.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price Of 5 oranges = Rs. 15

The selling price of 3 oranges = Rs. 5

**Concept Used:**

Loss = C.P - S.P

Loss percent = (loss/C.P) × 100 percent

**Calculation:**

The cost price of 5 oranges = Rs.15

Cost price of 1 orange = 15/5 = Rs. 3

The cost price of 3 oranges = 3×3 = Rs.9

The selling price of 3 oranges = 5

Loss %= (C.P - S.P) × 100 over C.P

Loss % = (9 - 5) × (100/9) %

Loss % = 400/9 % = 44 4over 9 %

**∴ The loss percentage is 44 4over 9** %
